name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets for a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets for a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets are built specifically for your kitchen's dimensions and design preferences, offering limitless options for materials, finishes, and features. Semi-custom cabinets are pre-manufactured in standard sizes but offer more style and finish choices than stock cabinets, with some modifications possible. Custom cabinets provide ultimate personalization, while semi-custom offer a good balance of cost and flexibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets are built to exact specifications, while semi-custom cabinets are pre-made with limited customization options, balancing cost and flexibility.
